name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 25, 2026 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84070910557
  Webinar ID: 840 7091 0557
  One-tap Mobile:
  +16469313860,,84070910557# OR +13017158592,,84070910557#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 646 931 3860 OR +1 301 715 8592
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Honig, Davis, Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Halpern,
  Mayor McSweeney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of February 11, 2026 Study Session and City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Lindsey Horvath, Third District Los Angeles County Board of Supervisor,
  Quarterly Office Update presented by Daniell Vicente, Las Virgenes &
  Topanga Field Deputy

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE AND LAS VIRGENES - LAS VIRGENES -
  MALIBU COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS (COG): UPDATE ON THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY SALES TAX MEASURE AND RELATED ASSEMBLY BILL
  1768, REQUEST FOR COUNCIL DIRECTION ON THE CITY’S POSITION FOR
  THE COG’s VOTE - Provide direction (per discussion) to the COG representative
  regarding the City’s position on the County’s sales tax measure and Assembly Bill
  1768.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 16-004 MODIFICATION NO. 5; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2437-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2437-26, determining Modification No. 5 of
  Conditional Use Permit No. 16-004 is exempt from CEQA and authorize a time
  extension, the sale of alcoholic beverages for onsite consumption, the sale of beer
  and wine for tasting and offsite consumption, indoor live entertainment, use of
  outdoor seating, food service, and extended operating hours for an existing
  brewery at 31125 Via Colinas, Suites 907 and 908 (14 Cannons).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2437-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVES A MODIFICATION TO CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 16-004, AUTHORIZING A TIME EXTENSION, THE SALE OF ALCOHOLIC
  BEVERAGES FOR ONSITE CONSUMPTION, THE SALE OF BEER AND WINE FOR
  TASTING AND OFFSITE CONSUMPTION, INDOOR LIVE ENTERTAINMENT, USE OF
  OUTDOOR SEATING, FOOD SERVICE, AND EXTENDED OPERATING HOURS FOR
  AN EXISTING BREWERY AT 31125 VIA COLINAS SUITES 907 AND 908 (14
  CANNONS)

2.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 15-003 MODIFICATION 2; RESOLUTION NO.
  2438-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2438-26, determining Conditional Use Permit No.
  15-003, Modification No. 2 is exempt from CEQA and authorize the continued
  operation of a Pilates studio located at 4613 Lakeview Canyon Road (Daily Breath
  Pilates).

  RESOLUTION NO. 2438-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 15-003,
  MODIFICATION NO. 2 TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED OPERATION OF A PILATES
  STUDIO LOCATED AT 4613 LAKEVIEW CANYON ROAD (DAILY BREATH PILATES)

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS:  Warrants effective February 15, 2026 in the
  amount of $456,902.12

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  2026 APPOINTMENTS TO THE COMMUNITY SERVICE GRANT
  ADVISORY COMMITTEE - Appoint Steve Kerman, Jeff France, Tish
  Matthews, Marcus Shapiro and Limor Magen to the 2026 Community
  Service Grant Advisory Committee.

  2.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION OF INTENTION TO AMEND
  CONTRACT WITH THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEE
  RETIREMENT SYSTEM; RESOLUTION NUMBER 2439-26 AND
  INTRODUCTION  OF  ORDINANCE  APPROVING  CONTRACT
  AMENDMENT; ORDINANCE NO. 313-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2439-26,
  waive the full reading and introduce Ordinance No. 313-26, approve a
  CEQA exemption, and schedule the second reading for March 25, 2026.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2439-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE DECLARING ITS INTENTION TO
  APPROVE AN AMENDMENT TO ITS CONTRACT WITH THE BOARD OF
  ADMINISTRATION CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT
  SYSTEM

  ORDINANCE NO. 313-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING AN AMENDMENT TO ITS
  CONTRACT WITH THE BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE CALIFORNIA
  PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM

  3.  ACCEPTANCE  OF  A  FUNDING  AGREEMENT  (FA
  9200000000MM550318)  WITH  LOS  ANGELES  COUNTY
  METROPOLITAN TRANSPORTATION AUTHORITY (LACMTA) FOR
  THE INTELLIGENT TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM SIGNAL PROJECT
  (PHASE II) - Enter into funding agreement FA 9200000000MM550318 in
  the amount of $495,000 with Los Angeles County Metropolitan
  Transportation Authority for the Westlake Village ITS Signal Project, Phase
  II and authorize the Mayor or City Manager to sign and execute the
  agreements on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS: None

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, February 19, 2026 at 4:45 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  February 19, 2026
